title: Keybinds & Shortcuts
summary: Reference controls for exploration, investigation, camp use, and field movement.
intro: This page lists the controls for Omni. The control scheme is built around quiet exploration, checking details, and returning to The Camp between routes.

shortcutGroups.title: Core Movement
shortcutGroups.description: Controls used while exploring the hospital, streets, routes, and camp.

entries.description: Move faster across open ground or unsafe routes.
Cross small obstacles, ledges, fences, and blocked paths.
Open the pause menu or close the current screen.

shortcutGroups.title: Interaction
shortcutGroups.description: Controls used to inspect the world and manage field information.

entries.description: Talk, pick up items, use doors, read notes, and operate stations.
Look closer at documents, faces, signals, or objects that seem wrong.
Review supplies, notes, tools, and collected evidence.
Open known routes, marked locations, camp notes, and objectives.

shortcutGroups.title: Field Tools
shortcutGroups.description: Controls for equipped tools and signal-related actions.

entries.description: Use the active item or confirm the focused action.
Use the equipped field tool or context item.
Cycle quick tools without opening the inventory.
Toggle light or check signal behavior in no-service zones.

sections.heading: Design Notes
paragraphs: The controls stay simple because the game depends on atmosphere and attention. The player thinks about what feels wrong instead of fighting the interface.
Investigation controls become more important than combat controls because Omni focuses on mystery, signal behavior, and almost-human encounters.
items: Keep movement, interact, inventory, and map easy to reach.
Use inspect/focus for details that are easy to miss in the environment.
Keep combat labels flexible until the threat model is clearer.
